lines.text: Emma loved a waterfall trail she hiked last spring.
She went back in November and the steps were icy, the falls half dry.
She'd forgotten what it was like, and when.
Here's the fix. After every hike, write down the date, the weather and the trail conditions, not just the name.
Next time you'll know the best month to go.
Now Emma plans her hikes from her own notes.
Save this before your next hike.
